canada.title: N.W.T. health officials confirm whooping cough outbreak in Behchokǫ̀
canada.summary: There is so far no evidence of broader regional spread of the infection, the health department said, and no cases had been reported outside of Behchokǫ̀ as of Wednesday.

canada.title: Pierre Poilievre says Alberta nurse may lose job after photo with him in Wainwright
canada.summary: Pierre Poilievre said a nurse working on contract at the CFB Wainwright has been told she might lose her job after she was photographed speaking with him after the tragedy.

canada.title: Lab results of more than 2,200 patients not sent to health-care providers, says NLHS
canada.summary: N.L. Health Services says that the lab results of over 2,000 patients were not sent to their health-care provider due to malfunction with the electronic medical record system.

canada.title: Sask. budget deficit shrinks to $784M in mid-year update
canada.summary: Finance Minister Jim Reiter says the fiscal update shows Saskatchewan remains resilient in the face of global uncertainty and market volatility.

canada.title: Manitoba premier dismisses renewed calls for child welfare system inquiry after girl's death
canada.summary: Manitoba's premier says his government already knows what's needed to fix the child welfare system, as the Official Opposition renews calls for an inquiry into the death of a girl under the care of Child and Family Services.

canada.title: Ford calls online gambling ads 'out of control,' says cabinet will look into problem
canada.summary: Ontario Premier Doug Ford said he has asked his cabinet to look into online gambling ads as his government faces increasing pressure from opposition MPPs to ban widespread advertising by the end of the year.

canada.title: Coastal flooding warning for Metro Vancouver as king tides coincide with storms across coastal B.C.
canada.summary: Many coastal communities of B.C. are preparing with sandbags and clearing debris as a king tide coincides with waves of heavy rain and wind on Wednesday.

canada.title: U.S. gov't urges judge to keep alleged Tumbler Ridge shooting co-conspirator locked up
canada.summary: The U.S. government is pushing for the alleged Tumbler Ridge shooting co-conspirator to stay behind bars. He argues Melody Bryant knew perfectly well that the shooter planned to commit a mass atrocity, and took concrete steps to further that plan.

canada.title: RCMP officer testifies at inquest into fatal 2021 police shooting in Rankin Inlet, Nunavut
canada.summary: Staff Sgt. Benjamin Comley was testifying at a coroner's inquest being held this week in Rankin Inlet, to examine the circumstances around the death of Trey Angootealuk, 22, who died in November 2021 in what police at the time described as a "shooting incident" involving RCMP.

canada.title: N.L. government moves to change deadline for review of electoral boundaries
canada.summary: The government is moving to give an extra year for a review of provincial electoral boundaries by independent commission. A bill making its way through the House of Assembly as of Wednesday evening would see a report due at the end of 2027.

canada.title: Mother hopes Saint John inquest into son’s death in custody not 'an exercise in futility’
canada.summary: The death of a Saint John man in police custody three years ago was an accident and the result of a combination of medication and alcohol toxicity, an inquest jury concluded Wednesday.

canada.title: Nova Scotia's new Liberal leader calling on PC government to pause AI data centre
canada.summary: Becky Druhan says the project should be paused until government establishes regulations to protect communities, electricity bills, water supply and the environment.

canada.title: 70-year-old man dead after falling through ice at Lake Louise
canada.summary: A long-time Banff resident died after falling through the ice while skating alone on Lake Louise.

canada.title: Driver in 2025 crash that killed father of 3 sentenced to 6.5 years
canada.summary: A driver in a head-on crash that killed a father of three last year and prompted the Ontario government to introduce tougher dangerous driving penalties has been sentenced to six years and six months behind bars.
canada.outlet: CBC News + Global News + CP24 (CP), Ottawa Citizen

canada.title: 3rd former Montreal police officer arrested and charged in connection with racism scandal
canada.summary: A third former Montreal police officer has been charged in connection with the racism scandal at Station 39 in the Montréal-Nord borough. Last Saturday, two other former officers were arrested and charged.

canada.title: N.S. launches Support Our Troops licence plate
canada.summary: Nova Scotia Premier Tim Houston unveiled the province’s latest specialty licence plate on Wednesday, something he said gives members of the public a way to show their support for people serving in the military.

canada.title: Family seeks answers in death of girl, 5, who was in CFS care
canada.summary: A family is mourning the death of a five-year-old girl who was in the care of Child and Family Services and seeking more information about what happened.

canada.title: Quebec man, one of Canada’s most wanted fugitives, arrested in Ontario
canada.summary: A 19-year-old Quebec man who was one of Canada’s most wanted fugitives has been arrested. Sûreté du Québec said Tuesday Ayoub Mohamed was arrested Monday by police in London, Ont.
